Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE COMPLETE THREE-PANEL VERTICAL COMIC EPISODE LETTERING PROOF for Vedansh Ramayan, high-resolution portrait approximately 1152 x 3072, intended as a vertically scrollable 390px-wide comic. It is not a phone mockup. No device frame, status bar, bottom navigation, controls or English metadata.
Input roles: image1 is the EXISTING episode artwork and locks the exact three actions, cast, costumes and appearances. Image2 is the APPROVED comic lettering/layout style: narration in cream rectangular boxes INSIDE the painted panels, true cream speech balloons with black outlines and speaker tails. Image3 locks queens' identities and sari colours. Image4 is supporting sage models only: the present Vishwamitra must be ELDERLY with long GREY beard as in image1, never the younger retrospective model. Image5 locks brothers' distinct faces, but use infants/children/adolescents appropriate to each scene, never the adult exile models.
STYLE: exact rich-colour Indian epic COMIC, decisive dark ink contours, flat/cel shading, emerald green, saffron, gold, cream. Not painterly, photorealistic or 3D. Keep every face, hand, baby and important action unobstructed. Recompose scenes around the lettering. Text boxes must sit inside the illustrated scene over background detail, never as a separate paragraph block underneath art. Full painted background behind and around boxes. No blank caption band, lower fifth, empty footer, border ornament or excessive margins. Narrow parchment gutters separate the three ink-bordered panels.
Top small dark-brown heading: "बालकाण्ड"
Main heading: "चार राजकुमार"
Small subtitle: "शैशव से किशोरावस्था तक समय बीतता है।"
No other header words.
Use clear professionally typeset looking Devanagari, large dark readable lettering, equivalent at least 18px when width is 390px. All following text MUST appear EXACTLY ONCE, verbatim with all matras and punctuation. Do not shorten, paraphrase, add text or invent a speaker. Fit the complete episode by letting the canvas be tall; never truncate captions or shrink lettering excessively.
PANEL 1 — palace birth celebration, recomposed from first reference top-left. Exactly THREE queens and FOUR babies: Kaushalya in red holds the ONLY blue baby Rama, Kaikeyi in royal blue holds natural-skin baby Bharata, Sumitra in yellow holds TWO natural-skin twins Lakshmana and Shatrughna. Older rounded-faced King Dasharatha in maroon/gold with crown and GREY moustache, no beard, smiles behind them. No other children, no second blue infant. All four infants clearly countable; adults' hands support them coherently. Caption box inset in the upper-left WITHIN palace scene, away from all heads:
"कौसल्या से राम, कैकेयी से भरत और सुमित्रा से लक्ष्मण तथा शत्रुघ्न जन्मे। महल में चारों बालकों के जन्म का उत्सव मनाया गया।"
No dialogue in this panel.
PANEL 2 — time passes, exactly FOUR SCHOOL-AGE princes learning with Vashishtha at a green gurukula beneath a tree. Rama is blue, calm rounder face and red sash; Lakshmana natural tan, narrow angular face, green sash; Bharata natural tan cream accent; Shatrughna natural tan teal accent. Clearly child proportions, no crowns or adult muscles. Vashishtha is a gentle old sage with FULL WHITE beard and cream robes, distinct from orange-clad Vishwamitra. Palm-leaf manuscripts, modest training bows resting nearby, trees/hermitage. Caption box IN upper-left canopy/background, never covering heads:
"चारों भाई शिक्षा और शस्त्रविद्या सीखते हुए बड़े हुए। राम-लक्ष्मण और भरत-शत्रुघ्न में विशेष स्नेह था।"
No dialogue.
PANEL 3 — the princes now ADOLESCENT, elderly long GREY-bearded Vishwamitra in orange and staff arrives on LEFT at Dasharatha's palace. Older GREY-MOUSTACHED Dasharatha in crown/maroon/gold at RIGHT, looking toward sage, makes respectful welcoming gesture. Adolescent Rama and Lakshmana stand nearby behind father, youthful faces, princely clothing, no crown, no exile matted locks. Preserve distinct Rama/Lakshmana face models. Exactly these four principal figures. Caption box at upper-left inside palace painting:
"जब राजकुमार किशोर हुए, महर्षि विश्वामित्र दशरथ के दरबार आए। राजा ने उन्हें सम्मान देकर उनके आगमन का प्रयोजन पूछा।"
ONE speech balloon in the upper-right / middle-right scene space, positioned separately below narration and above Dasharatha. Its pointed tail must unambiguously END NEAR DASHARATHA'S MOUTH on the right, not the sage or either prince. Exact balloon text:
"मुनिवर, मैं आपकी क्या सेवा करूँ?"
No speaker name label inside bubble. No caption below panel. Show enough of Dasharatha to make him immediately identifiable as speaker. All text comfortably inside borders and never over faces/hands. Preserve story order BIRTH -> EDUCATION -> SAGE'S ARRIVAL; there is no departure, wedding or forest adventure in this episode. Keep original scene content complete and modest. The end is the king's question awaiting the next episode.
